mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.0% signals economic weakness, prompting equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate deteriorating consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising industrial production (INDPRO above 105) signals sustained economic strength without overheating, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO exceeds 105 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 238 indicates elevated inflation, increasing the risk of monetary tightening and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 238 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding economic output, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is rising (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 238) signals a dovish monetary policy environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 238 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Weak job growth (PAYEMS below 140,000) indicates slowing labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is below 140,000 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
